P_calibration.quote: 18 U.S.C. § 1001 might reach knowingly false statements, but the bill should impose its own penalties.
P_calibration.note: also: A joint resolution is ordinary legislation that requires the President's signature, so this clause adds nothing to Congress's existing power to repeal.

P_grandfather_step.quote: companies have a strong incentive to start very large runs before the bill becomes law.
